name: Autorouter
description: Autoroute the open board with Freerouting without leaving the PCB editor
description_full: One toolbar button runs the Freerouting autorouter on the open board: the board is exported to Specctra DSN, Freerouting 2.5 runs headless in the background with live pass-by-pass progress, and the routed session is imported back as a single undoable step. Choose passes, via costs, optimizer strategy, routable layers, preferred directions and net classes to skip. The engine and a Java runtime are downloaded into the plugin's data folder on first use; nothing is installed system-wide. For KiCad 9 and 10.
